occur.en: It also occurs inside English when switching between formal and informal styles.
occur.zh: 它也发生在英语内部正式风格和非正式风格的切换中。

occur.en: It also occurs in places where the systems that are supposed to stop corruption are weak.
occur.zh: 它也发生在那些本应用来阻止腐败的体制十分薄弱的地方。

occur.en: Natural resources are materials that occur naturally and can be removed from the ground and then sold.
occur.zh: 自然资源是自然产生、可以从地下开采并随后出售的物质。

occur.en: Landslides and mudslides which can occur after heavy rainfall make earth or mud move downhill very fast.
occur.zh: “Landslides”（山体滑坡）和“mudslides”（泥石流）可能在强降雨后发生，使泥土或泥浆极快地向山下移动。

occur.en: It commonly occurs when the speaker changes the topic or the tone or maybe responds to a new person.
occur.zh: 它通常发生在说话者改变话题、语气或可能在回应一个新人的时候。

occasionally.en: In the evening, a thin broth, or very occasionally a small portion of cooked meat.
occasionally.zh: 晚上是一碗稀薄的肉汤，偶尔极少有一小份煮熟的肉。

occasionally.en: The phrases once in a while and from time to time mean occasionally, not very often.
occasionally.zh: 短语once in a while和from time to time的意思是偶尔，不经常。

occasionally.en: The phrases once in a while and from time to time mean occasionally – sometimes, but not very often.
occasionally.zh: 短语once in a while和from time to time的意思是偶尔——有时，但不经常。

occasionally.en: Volatility means prices change quickly and occasionally change dramatically.
occasionally.zh: 波动性意味着价格变化迅速，有时甚至发生巨大变化。

occasionally.en: I see this at my conversation clubs occasionally.
occasionally.zh: 我偶尔在我的英语角俱乐部里看到这种情况。

occurrence.en: Church was, of course, a regular occurrence.
occurrence.zh: 当然，做礼拜是必不可少的常规活动。

occurrence.en: Executions became an almost daily occurrence.
occurrence.zh: 处决几乎成了家常便饭。

occurrence.en: Yeah, or as my daughters would say, "I've had a mare today." And when they say mare, which is obviously shortened from 'nightmare', what it basically means is they've had a mild and potentially slightly humorous occurrence at work.
occurrence.zh: 是的，或者像我女儿们会说的，“我今天过得很 mare。”当她们说 mare 时，这显然是 nightmare 的缩写，其基本意思是她们在工作中遇到了一些轻微的、可能还有点幽默的小插曲。

occasion.en: To celebrate the occasion, I wrote a Thinking in English Bonus Episode on the things I achieved or was proud of doing in my twenties.
occasion.zh: 为了庆祝这个时刻，我写了一期 Thinking in English 的特别节目，盘点我在二十多岁时取得的成就或引以为豪的事情。

occasion.en: Mediterranean cultures have other advantages too, including outdoor exercise, which is easier in warm climates, and communal meals, occasions when people sit down and share food together.
occasion.zh: 地中海文化还有其他优势，包括户外运动（在温暖气候下更容易进行）以及集体用餐（人们坐在一起分享食物的场合）。

occasion.en: On one occasion, for example, bombs were found under an apartment block, and FSB agents were seen placing them, but when pressed, the government said that it was simply a training exercise.
occasion.zh: 例如，曾有一次，人们在一栋公寓楼下发现了炸弹，并看到FSB特工在安放炸弹，但当受到追问时，政府却声称这只是一次军事演习。

occasion.en: He had met Hitler on several occasions, and Hitler had always been polite and courteous to him; after all, the sacrifices this man had made for the Nazi cause were plain to see.
occasion.zh: 他曾多次见过希特勒，希特勒对他也总是彬彬有礼、客客气气；毕竟，这个人为了纳粹事业所做出的牺牲是有目共睹的。

occasion.en: But back to Blackwater. After the controversy of the Nisour Square massacre, and growing criticism about how much money it was making from the US government, it rebranded itself several times and has been sold and repackaged on numerous occasions.
occasion.zh: 言归正传，回到黑水公司。在尼苏尔广场屠杀事件的争议以及对其从美国政府赚取巨额资金的日益批评之后，它多次更改品牌，并在许多场合被出售和重新包装。

occupy.en: Day and night, people occupied the square, camping out despite the threat of violence.
occupy.zh: 日以继夜，人们占领了广场，不顾暴力威胁在那里露营。

occupy.en: He coordinated the paperwork between police forces and administrative departments across a dozen occupied countries.
occupy.zh: 他还负责协调十几个被占领国家之间警察部门与行政机构的文书工作。

occupy.en: Greece occupied the western region of Anatolia, of modern-day Turkey, while Italy took the south.
occupy.zh: 希腊占领了现代土耳其的安纳托利亚西部地区，而意大利则占领了南部。

occupy.en: Across the world museums display artifacts taken from colonized or occupied societies.
occupy.zh: 世界各地的博物馆都陈列着从被殖民或被占领社会掠夺来的文物。

occupy.en: It only occupied a narrow strip of land along the Atlantic coast.
occupy.zh: 它只占领了大西洋沿岸的一狭长地带。

occupation.en: The occupation ended in 1945 when Japan surrendered at the end of the Second World War.
occupation.zh: 占领于1945年结束，当时日本在二战结束时投降。

occupation.en: Society might be hierarchical. This means people have different occupations, classes, and roles.
occupation.zh: 社会可能是等级森严的。这意味着人们有不同的职业、阶层和角色。

occupation.en: Under Nazi occupation, Warsaw became the site of some of the worst atrocities of the war.
occupation.zh: 在纳粹占领下，华沙成为了这场战争中最惨绝人寰的暴行发生地之一。

occupation.en: Their goal was to save Warsaw from German occupation before Soviet forces entered the city.
occupation.zh: 他们的目标是在苏联军队进入城市之前，将华沙从德国占领中解放出来。

occupation.en: Berlin as the capital was also split into four occupation sectors.
occupation.zh: 作为首都的柏林也被分成了四个占领区。
